risks: CLAIM | "STATUS / DISTILL answers are computed locally — no spend, no egress." | _status, _distill | KEPT | Both call only local functions (bridge_status, cached_index, semantic_slice) and return deterministic envelopes with provider_used="deterministic".

CLAIM | "ENQUEUE only PROPOSES a confirm-gated task; nothing runs until the UI posts the confirmation to /api/queue (which funnels through process_bridge_payload)." | _enqueue | KEPT | _enqueue returns an envelope with intent="enqueue" and action; it does not execute the task itself.

CLAIM | "the LLM brain ... only ever produces TEXT. It never executes an action." | _chat, _llm | UNCHECKABLE | The _chat function is not shown in this chunk; need to see _llm and _chat to verify they never execute actions.

CLAIM | "the model advises, Daedalus acts (behind confirmation + the verify-or-rollback gate)." | general | KEPT | The code enforces a separation: _enqueue proposes, confirmation is handled externally via /api/queue, and _decide/act provide capability gating.

CLAIM | ``deterministic``  status / distill / design. Computed here, locally. No spend, no egress, no model." | _status, _distill, _design | KEPT | _status and _distill are local; _design is not shown but route "design" is in _SHELL_BY_ROUTE as deterministic.

CLAIM | ``hand`` ... Inside this module the Hand shell only ever PROPOSES a confirm-gated task -- the executor itself runs later, asynchronously, via the bridge into ``providers/ollama.py``. Nothing here calls a tool." | _enqueue | KEPT | _enqueue returns an envelope with action; it does not call any tool or executor.

CLAIM | ``hand`` ... A CONFIRMED route additionally requires the executor to be MEASURED ``working`` (see :func:`_enqueue`): confirming is the moment the system commits work to the Hand, and it refuses in words rather than committing on "I don't know"." | _enqueue | KEPT | _enqueue checks hand.state != "working" for confirmed and returns a refusal envelope.

CLAIM | ``hand`` ... An unconfirmed proposal commits nothing, so it proposes regardless -- reporting the executor's state when it happens to know it, and claiming nothing when it does not." | _enqueue | KEPT | For unconfirmed (confirmed=False), _hand_state is called with probe=False (cache only) and the result is not used to refuse.
CLAIM | ``voice`` ... Every branch of :func:`_llm` lives here." | _chat, _llm | UNCHECKABLE | _llm is not shown; need to see that _llm is only called from _chat.

CLAIM | "Every ``start`` event, every envelope, and every persisted turn carries the shell that answered, so "which one of the three spoke" is a recorded fact and not an inference from the provider name." | _shell_for, shell in envelopes | KEPT | Envelopes include shell parameter (SHELL_DETERMINISTIC, SHELL_HAND, SHELL_VOICE) set by _shell_for based on route.
CLAIM | "For ``chat`` intents the client-supplied ``provider`` parameter REMAINS honored, exactly as before." | _ask_inner | KEPT | _ask_inner passes provider to _chat for route "chat".

CLAIM | "For any intent the capability predicate clears for tools, THE EXECUTOR IS CHOSEN BY THE SYSTEM. ``provider`` is not consulted, not defaulted from, and not echoed into the proposed action: :func:`_enqueue` does not take it as an argument, so a client cannot name its way onto the tool-bearing path." | _enqueue | KEPT | _enqueue does not accept provider parameter; _ask_inner does not pass provider to _enqueue.

CLAIM | ":func:`classify` runs exactly once per request. Both entry points derive ``(intent, act)`` at the top and thread the labels down; nothing below re-derives them." | ask, ask_stream | UNCHECKABLE | ask_stream is not shown; need to verify ask_stream also derives intent and act once.

CLAIM | ":func:`_route` folds the intent answer and the capability answer into ONE effective label, which is what the streaming ``start`` event announces and what every ``final`` is built from -- so a client that has already committed to an affordance (or, later, to speech) cannot be handed a ``final`` that contradicts it." | _route | KEPT | _route combines intent and act into a single route string; envelopes use this route to determine shell.
CLAIM | ":func:`_reconcile_final` is the tripwire for the case that should now be unreachable." | _reconcile_final | UNCHECKABLE | _reconcile_final is not shown in this chunk.

CLAIM | "A provider string not in any of these sets still falls back to the deterministic layer -- cleanly, via _llm()'s final `return None, None, _EMPTY_CTX` -- rather than crashing or guessing at a different brain." | _llm | UNCHECKABLE | _llm is not shown; need to see its fallback behavior.
CLAIM | "_llm() below deliberately builds their brain context with lane="untrusted", never "trusted" like Ollama/Claude get." | _llm | UNCHECKABLE | _llm is not shown; need to verify lane assignment.

CLAIM | "_decide ... A predicate that raises must not become a predicate that permits, so the exception path returns a refusal rather than propagating." | _decide | KEPT | _decide catches Exception and returns ActDecision(False, ...).

CLAIM | "The capability answer WINS DOWNWARD only. It can pull a message off the tool-bearing route ... and it can put a confirmed offer back ON it — but a confirmation is itself a cleared act decision, so nothing reaches ``enqueue`` that ``may_act`` did not allow." | _route | KEPT | _route returns "enqueue" only if act.allowed and act.confirmation_of; returns "chat" if intent="enqueue" and not act.allowed.

CLAIM | "conversation_id is read-only here: it is used to look up the previous turn for :func:`_decide` and nothing else." | _ask_inner | KEPT | _ask_inner only passes conversation_id to _decide (via _prior_turn).

CLAIM | "Fails to ``unknown`` if health itself cannot be consulted — never to ``working``, because uncertainty about liveness must not read as health." | _hand_state | KEPT | Exception handler sets state to "unknown".

CLAIM | "probe=False answers FROM THE CACHE ONLY and returns ``None`` rather than making a network call." | _hand_state | KEPT | When probe=False and cache miss, returns None without calling health.hand_state.

CLAIM | "the advisory paths (a proposal, which commits nothing) therefore look but do not knock, and say nothing at all when they do not know; only the paths where the answer CHANGES THE OUTCOME pay for it." | _enqueue | KEPT | For unconfirmed, _hand_state(probe=False) is called; result is not used to refuse.

CLAIM | "A host that has not answered in 2s is `unknown`, which is honest -- and `unknown` is not clearance (see _enqueue)." | _hand_state, _enqueue | KEPT | timeout_s=2.0 set; _enqueue refuses on anything other than "working".

D1 | _hand_state parameter `probe` | The parameter `probe` is defined but never read within the function body; it is only used in the condition `if not probe: return None` which does not read its value beyond the boolean check. | WRONG CONCLUSION: A caller might think probe controls caching behavior, but the function ignores its value after the early return.

D2 | _ask_inner parameter `conversation_id` | The parameter `conversation_id` is accepted but never read in _ask_inner; it is only passed to _decide via the call, but _decide ignores it because it calls _prior_turn with the same argument. | WRONG CONCLUSION: A caller might think _ask_inner uses conversation_id for something else, but it only passes it through.
